basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) has announced 1 vacancy for the Jr. Research Fellow post on a project-based, contractual basis. The appointment carries a consolidated pay of Rs. 37,000p.m. plus HRA @27% and is renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier. Candidates applying for the Jr. Research Fellow position must possess a 1st class B.Tech/M.Tech/M.Sc in Electrical Engineering Electronics and Communication engineering/Physics/Engineering physics or other relevant field, with a strong knowledge of electromagnetics and GATE/NET qualification. content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Jr. Research Fellow at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi)

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Jr. Research Fellow position under the Optics and Photonics Centre.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the following essential and desirable criteria for the Jr. Research Fellow position: Essential Qualification: 1st class B.Tech/M.Tech/M.Sc in Electrical Engineering Electronics and Communication engineering/Physics/Engineering physics or other relevant field. A strong knowledge of electromagnetics is necessary. GATE/NET is also required. Desirable Qualification: A prior experience with photonics (either simulation or experiments) will be preferred. Qualification Relaxation: The requirement of a qualifying NET/GATE qualification may be relaxed for candidates who have graduated from Centrally Funded Technical Institutes (CFTIs) with a CGPA of more than 8.00 (80% aggregate marks), meritorious candidates. Category Relaxation: 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to the SC/ST candidates. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated fellowship of Rs. 37,000/- per month plus HRA at the rate of 27%. The appointment is made on a contractual basis subject to periodic performance review, and is renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier. In case of selection of a retired/superannuated government employee, his/her salary will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: IIT Delhi reserves the right to fix higher criteria for short-listing of eligible candidates from those satisfying advertised qualification and requirement of the project post and their name will be displayed on web link (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted) alongwith the online interview details. Only short-listed candidates will be informed for online interview. In case any clarification is required on eligibility regarding the above post, the candidate may contact to Prof. Awanish Pandey (email id: [email protected] ).

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for IIT Delhi Jr. Research Fellow?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the Jr. Research Fellow post under the specified project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the completed applications by email is 03/11/2026 by 5.00 p.m.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a 1st class B.Tech/M.Tech/M.Sc in Electrical Engineering Electronics and Communication engineering/Physics/Engineering physics or other relevant field, along with a strong knowledge of electromagnetics and GATE/NET qualification.

faq.question: Q4. Is the NET/GATE requirement mandatory for everyone?
faq.answer: GATE/NET is required, but the requirement may be relaxed for candidates who have graduated from Centrally Funded Technical Institutes (CFTIs) with a CGPA of more than 8.00 (80% aggregate marks), meritorious candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated pay of Rs. 37,000/- p.m. plus HRA @27%.

faq.question: Q6. How can candidates apply for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD Website (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec) of IIT Delhi and submit the duly filled form with complete information regarding educational qualifications indicating percentage of marks/division, details of work experience etc. by e-mail with advertisement No. on the subject line to Prof. Awanish Pandey at email id: [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. How is the selection process conducted?
faq.answer: IIT Delhi reserves the right to fix higher criteria for short-listing of eligible candidates from those satisfying advertised qualification and requirement of the project post and their name will be displayed on web link (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted) alongwith the online interview details. Only short-listed candidates will be informed for online interview.

faq.question: Q8. Can retired government employees apply for this position?
faq.answer: In case of selection of a retired/superannuated government employee, his/her salary will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms.
